title: Instagram Hashtag Crawling - Normal Flow
description: Verify that the crawler correctly collects posts from Instagram hashtags relevant to Gyeongnam art events without duplicates and with error rate below threshold.

steps.description: Trigger the Instagram hashtag crawler to collect data
Check collected posts are stored in the database
Verify no duplicate posts are saved beyond the allowed 20% threshold
Confirm error rate of crawling is below 5%

title: Public Institution Website Crawling - Edge Cases and Error Handling
description: Validate crawler behavior when the public institution websites have invalid HTML, slow response, or missing data fields.

steps.description: Simulate crawling of public sites with malformed HTML
Crawler handles invalid HTML without crashing and skips problematic entries
Simulate slow server response from public site
Crawler respects timeout limits and retries appropriately
Simulate missing required metadata fields in collected posts
Crawler flags incomplete data and does not store invalid entries

title: AI Metadata Extraction Accuracy
description: Test that AI-based metadata extraction (using Google Gemini AI) accurately extracts event name, date, location, and description from raw content.

steps.description: Feed sample raw event data to AI metadata extractor
Verify extracted metadata matches expected values with at least 95% accuracy
Test with ambiguous or noisy input data
Ensure extractor handles ambiguity gracefully and flags uncertain fields

title: Duplicate Detection Logic
description: Verify the system detects duplicates effectively and removes them to keep duplicate rate under 20%.

steps.description: Input multiple event entries with overlapping metadata simulating duplicates
System identifies duplicates and removes or marks them accordingly
Final stored data has duplicates below 20% threshold

title: Image Optimization and Storage
description: Check that event images are optimized in size and resolution, and correctly stored in Supabase Storage with permanent URL linkage.

steps.description: Upload raw images via crawler or admin upload
Verify images are optimized (thumbnails created, size reduced)
Confirm images are stored in Supabase Storage with correct permissions and retention

title: Admin Dashboard Workflow - Data Verification and Approval
description: Verify that the admin dashboard allows efficient review of collected data with UI response time under 200ms and that admins can approve, reject (as spam), or send DMs efficiently within 30 seconds per item.

steps.description: Login to admin dashboard
Load data entry for review
Ensure page loads within 200ms
Perform approval workflow: reject spam, approve promising info, send DM to artist
Validate admin can complete workflow within 30 seconds per item

title: Admin Dashboard - DM Management and Response Handling
description: Test that DMs sent to artists via the admin dashboard are correctly sent and admin can update approval status based on artist response.

steps.description: Send DM via dashboard to artist for event confirmation
Confirm DM is sent and notification received via Telegram
Receive artist response (approve or reject)
Dashboard updates event status correctly based on response

title: User Website - Event Search and Filtering
description: Verify that users can search and filter events by date, category, location with results displayed visually and page loads within 3 seconds.

steps.description: Navigate to user event search page
Apply filters: event date, category, location
Results are filtered correctly and displayed with event images
Page loads in 3 seconds or less

title: User Event Detail and Sharing Functionality
description: Validate that users can view detailed event information and share event details through supported platforms.

steps.description: Click on event from listing to open detail page
All event details (name, date, location, images, description) are visible and accurate
Share event using provided share buttons
Sharing functionality correctly opens respective platform (e.g., social media or copy link)

title: Security - Admin Access Control
description: Ensure only authorized admins can access the admin dashboard and perform data curation and DM sending, with proper authentication and role-based permissions.

steps.description: Attempt to access admin dashboard without login
Access is denied and redirected to login page
Login as admin with valid credentials
Dashboard is accessible with admin privileges
Login as regular user and try to access admin dashboard
Access is denied due to insufficient permissions

title: System Uptime and Recovery
description: Simulate system failures and verify that system uptime is maintained above 99.5% and recovery time after failure is under 1 hour.

steps.description: Simulate server crash or network outage
System monitoring alerts via Telegram are triggered
Recover service and restore functionality
Full service restoration within 1 hour
Verify overall uptime remains above 99.5% over monitoring period

title: Telegram Notification System
description: Confirm that Telegram-based notifications are sent to admins for system status and data collection updates reliably and in real-time.

steps.description: Trigger system event requiring notification (e.g., crawling completed, error detected)
Telegram notification is received by admin immediately
Verify that notification content is accurate and actionable

title: Privacy Compliance and Data Protection
description: Test that user data and event data handle privacy laws compliance, with proper consent and secure storage mechanisms.

steps.description: Attempt to access sensitive data without proper authorization
Access denied and data protection enforced
Check that user personal data collected via website is encrypted and stored securely
Data is encrypted at rest and in transit
Verify consent workflow for users to agree to privacy terms
Operations that require user data comply with consent and privacy laws

title: Performance - API Response Times Under Load
description: Measure API response times for backend endpoints under expected user loads to ensure responses are within 200ms.

steps.description: Simulate concurrent user requests to key APIs (search, event details, admin data)
API response times remain under 200ms for at least 95% of requests

title: User Experience - Mobile First Responsive Design
description: Validate that the user website's UI is mobile-first, responsive, and usable on common mobile devices and resolutions.

steps.description: Open user event site on various mobile devices and screen sizes
UI elements are displayed correctly without overflow or truncation
Navigation and filtering are usable and intuitive on touch screens
